scripts.tauri:dev: cargo build -p pipi-sandbox && node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs debug && tauri dev --config crates/pipi/tauri.conf.json
scripts.tauri:desktop: mkdir -p target/pipi-desktop && CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/target/pipi-desktop" PIPI_DESKTOP_NO_WATCH=1 flock -n target/pipi-desktop/.pipi-launch.lock sh -c 'node scripts/prepare-desktop-dev.mjs && exec npm run tauri:dev -- --no-watch'
scripts.tauri:build: cargo build --release -p pipi-sandbox && node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs release && tauri build --config crates/pipi/tauri.conf.json
